translations.web: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
translations.bsb: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
translations.kjv: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
translations.asv: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.
